text:
Wow! I truly have never had such good orthodontic treatment. The staff are so lovely. The doctor is truly an expert and explains every step of the process.
My permanent retainer broke sometime ago and I’m so regretful for not visiting sooner. It feels better now than when I first had it installed!
Thank you so much. I’m so grateful 🙏🏻🙌🏻✨
